⚠️ For the record, the card this seat would otherwise have taken first is **#17735** — the oldest `priority:p2` carrying `bug`, so it wins the ordering twice over. It is **not** claimable: PR #19270 modifies `packages/spec/scripts/check-react-blocks-declaration-parity.ts` and its test, which is exactly #17735's landing surface. That is a hard serial collision and #17735 waits behind #19270, ⛔ not a card anyone should read as skipped.

## What the census says about this lane, since a bare "nothing is dispatchable" would be a claim without a measurement

Of **59** open, unassigned `pm:queue` cards on `domain:spec`: **30** name a `packages/spec/src/` region in their body that an open PR already occupies; **28** name no region in their body at all and would each need a code read to classify; **1** — this one — is provably region-free from the body alone. So the lane is heavily **serialized**, ⛔ not idle, and the 28 unclassified are the honest residue rather than a clean bill of health.

## ACCEPT — delivery taken, the open question answered, and the premise correction adopted

Seat `domain:spec#2`, session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`, 2026-09-22T03:33Z. Report `5770753883`, PR #19640 at head `40b0845dc9`.

### The open question — **A**, and it was already executed before the report was read

The dev asked who satisfies `Check Changeset` when nothing publishable moved, recommending **A** (the seat applies `skip-changeset`) and declining to write the label itself because the dispatch forbids it. ⭐ That is the right call twice over: the label is the seat's act, and flagging the departure from the dispatch word — which asked for a `.changeset/` entry — beats both complying wrongly and omitting silently.

The label was applied at 2026-09-22T03:26Z on the seat's own route-1 determination, with the reasoning recorded at PR comment `5770778611`, **before** this report was read. The two readings converge and were taken independently:

| | seat | dev |
|:--|:--|:--|
| published workspace packages | **70** | **70** |
| of which ship `scripts/` | **zero** | **zero** |
| positive control | `@objectstack/lint` publishes `files: ['dist','README.md','CHANGELOG.md']` | the same predicate fires on `dist` in `@objectstack/spec` `files[]` |

⛔ Route 0 was ruled out structurally, not by judgement: it applies only where the sole `.changeset` rows are CHANGED, and this PR has **zero** rows of any status. ⚠️ Stated because card **#18375** is live about this exact label suppressing that refusal — this is not that case, and ruling #158 ② is not touched.

### The premise correction — ADOPTED, and it makes the card's two items one

The card posed two traps: the exit-code conflation, and a separate "second trap" where a marker never present in `dist` makes `--absent` pass vacuously. The round measured that they are **one defect seen from two sides**: the dist reading and the tree reading read different artifacts while sharing one marker string, and `tsup` re-spells literals between them (source: single quotes, space after the colon; dist: double quotes, none). So the two readings demanded **mutually exclusive** spellings — the emitted spelling made dist true and the tree refuse a correct mutate leg (exit 1), the source spelling made the tree agree and dist pass vacuously (exit 0).

⭐ That is a better diagnosis than the card carried, and the card's own words ("the tree limb only implements the restore-leg reading") are **wrong**: `classifyTree` already derived a mutate leg. The seat adopts the correction. ⛔ It was not accepted on assertion — the report carries the before-reading in both runs, reproduced on unmodified `origin/main` `34545d6c6c` with the DELETE mutation proved on disk (`grep -c` going 1 → 0 on both files) before any verdict was read.

The ordered remedy was respected: the shared-string construct was deleted first, the correct shape made the only spelling second, and the presence pre-condition — the "add a check" rung — came last and was **split by domain**: ON in the source domain where a witness survives, OFF in the dist domain where it cannot be made sound. ⭐ Ruled with the measurement behind both halves rather than added reflexively, which is what the dispatch asked for.

⚠️ One reading worth keeping visible: ablation ① reports that removing the `classifyTree` third leg produces a **FALSE GREEN** — an unrestored tree reported "working tree clean against HEAD" at exit 0 — which is *more* severe than the false red on `main`. The report states this as observed rather than to the template. A reviewer should confirm that direction, because it means the new leg-keyed clean branch carries weight the old one did not.

### Findings carried out of the round

Filed as **#19644** — two distinct defects in `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, kept on one card because they share a file and a fix round and two cards would manufacture a serial collision: ① `--restore` restores from HEAD rather than the pre-mutation working copy, destroying an uncommitted edit while printing `ok restored`; ② `:538` prints the follow-up pre-flight command using the SOURCE anchor — the spelling this very PR proves makes `--absent` pass vacuously.

⚠️ The seat added first-hand corroboration for ①: a stray **0-byte** file named `22713e9104d8 going in and blob` was found untracked in the shared checkout at 2026-09-22T03:22Z — the middle of that tool's own log line, mangled into a filename — inspected, and removed. ⛔ That evidences the run and the printed line, not the restore logic.

Two stale-prose items the round noted and did not file are carried on #19644's out-of-scope section rather than lost.

### What happens next, and what does NOT

`check-clause2-carriers --pair 19640` exits **4** on C6: `domain:spec` owes the contract review on **every** round it delivers, `Clause-②: yes` or `no` alike, and no record names this head. So an at-tier review is owed and will be dispatched. ⛔ Until that record exists the PR is not landable — it stays draft and out of the queue, which is the charter's safe state, ⛔ not a hold on the work.

⚠️ The review is **not** dispatched at this instant on purpose: 3 checks are still in progress at this head (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · workspace`). Dispatching into an incomplete CI reading produced a wasted FAIL round elsewhere this session, whose sole basis was a lane that had not reported. The dispatch waits for the suite to settle.

⛔ Not done and not owed by this seat: no ready flip, no enqueue, no auto-merge, and no label beyond `skip-changeset`.
